record.original_question: Can motivic integration for Deligne-Mumford stacks be developed over a complete discrete valuation ring of mixed characteristic and applied to the McKay correspondence?

evidence.quote: Problem 10.1. Develop motivic integration for Deligne-Mumford stacks over a com- plete discrete valuation ring of mixed characteristics and apply it to the proof of McKay correspondence over such a ring.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $R$ be a complete discrete valuation ring of mixed characteristic (for example, the ring of $p$-adic integers $\mathbb{Z}_p$), with residue field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ and fraction field $K$ of characteristic $0$. Existing theories of motivic integration provide, for a formal scheme $\mathfrak{X}$ of finite type over $R$, a measure on the arc space (or Greenberg space) of $\mathfrak{X}$ valued in a suitable Grothendieck ring of varieties, generalizing Kontsevich's motivic integration and Sebag's extension to formal schemes. Parallel work has developed motivic integration over (possibly wild) Deligne–Mumford stacks $\mathcal{X}$ in the equal-characteristic setting, i.e., over power series rings $k[[t]]$, and used it to establish motivic forms of the McKay correspondence, including for wild quotient singularities.

Problem: Develop a theory of motivic integration for Deligne–Mumford stacks $\mathcal{X}$ that are of finite type (or formal of finite type) over a complete discrete valuation ring $R$ of mixed characteristic, including:

(a) a well-defined notion of twisted arcs / jets of $\mathcal{X}$ over $R$ and an appropriate Greenberg-type space carrying a measure with values in a localized Grothendieck ring of varieties over the residue field $k$;
(b) a change-of-variables formula along proper birational (and in particular crepant) morphisms between such stacks; and
(c) using this theory, prove a motivic McKay correspondence over $R$: for a finite group $G$ acting linearly on $\mathbb{A}^n_R$ with quotient $X = \mathbb{A}^n_R/G$ and any crepant resolution (or stacky resolution) $Y \to X$, establish an equality of stringy/motivic invariants of $Y$ with a suitable orbifold/twisted-arc motivic integral on the quotient stack $[\mathbb{A}^n_R/G]$, recovering in mixed characteristic the wild McKay correspondence known in equal characteristic.
artifact.status_search_result: Motivic integration over Deligne–Mumford stacks has been developed in equal characteristic (over power series rings $k[[t]]$), including the wild case, leading to a wild motivic McKay correspondence. While Sebag's motivic integration for formal schemes covers mixed characteristic, no published extension to Deligne–Mumford stacks over a complete DVR of mixed characteristic, together with a McKay correspondence application, appears in the literature. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Motivic integration over wild Deligne-Mumford stacks
status_evidence.snippet: Develops motivic integration over formal Deligne-Mumford stacks over a power series ring of arbitrary characteristic, with application to wild McKay correspondence.
status_evidence.claim: Stack-theoretic motivic integration and McKay correspondence are established in equal characteristic, not mixed characteristic.

status_evidence.title: Motivic integration, the McKay correspondence and wild ramification (Yasuda)
status_evidence.snippet: Book treating motivic integration and McKay correspondence over equal-characteristic local rings; mixed-characteristic case discussed as a future direction.
status_evidence.claim: The mixed-characteristic stack-theoretic case is mentioned as not yet developed.
